interop-psd SoCo, GdFl, PtFl descriptors map to those records (all gradient styles, angle, scale, reverse, dither, align, offset, colour+transparency stop merge, pattern id to minted pattern tile); block bytes stay in the document and export is unchanged; shape layers (fill + vmsk/vsms), noise gradients, non-RGB colours, out-of-range values, unknown fields stay preserved or reported with fixed codes
